name: unknown_ids_on_the_remaining_read_endpoints_each_return_their_own_not_found_code
setup: empty database, logical clock pinned to 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z; no district, roll, drive, period, plan, program, claim, record or dispute exists

payload.note: well-formed board action against an id that does not exist

assert: every one of the eleven calls returns 404
the lodging-business read returns data.error_id == ERR_LODGING_BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND
the petition-drive read returns data.error_id == ERR_PETITION_DRIVE_NOT_FOUND
the petition-signature read returns data.error_id == ERR_PETITION_SIGNATURE_NOT_FOUND
the assessment-period read returns data.error_id == ERR_ASSESSMENT_PERIOD_NOT_FOUND
the annual-work-plan read returns data.error_id == ERR_WORK_PLAN_NOT_FOUND
the marketing-program read returns data.error_id == ERR_MARKETING_PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND
the room-night-claim read returns data.error_id == ERR_ROOM_NIGHT_CLAIM_NOT_FOUND
the transparency-record read returns data.error_id == ERR_TRANSPARENCY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND
the assessment-dispute read returns data.error_id == ERR_DISPUTE_NOT_FOUND
the statement-generation write returns data.error_id == ERR_ASSESSMENT_PERIOD_NOT_FOUND

the board-action write returns 404 with data.error_id == ERR_WORK_PLAN_NOT_FOUND rather than ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION or ERR_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES, because path-id existence at priority 40 is resolved before every state and business rule from priority 60 onwards; the body is well formed, so the priority-30 shape gate has nothing to say about it
the nine error_id values are nine distinct strings, so no pair of entities shares a 404 code

name: the_contingency_cap_and_the_marketing_floor_both_refuse_a_plan_at_board_approval
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with the four-property roll; no assessment period and no statement exist, so any funding_ratio computed for fiscal 2027 is 0.0000

expenditure_lines.narrative: one cent over the statutory reserve

payload.note: board vote on the over-reserved plan

expenditure_lines.narrative: one cent short of the marketing floor

payload.note: board vote on the under-marketed plan

assert: both plan creations return 201 even though neither mix is compliant, because the caps bind at APPROVE and not at creation

AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_cont_id}.total_budget_cents == 1000000 with contingency_reserve_cents == 100001, and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_mkt_id}.total_budget_cents == 1000000 with sales_and_marketing_cents == 599999
both SPONSOR calls return 200 and leave each plan in BOARD_REVIEW with sponsor_user_id == "board-member-01"
the first APPROVE returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_CONTINGENCY_SHARE_EXCEEDED, because round_half_up(1000000 * 0.10) == 100000 and 100001 > 100000
the second APPROVE returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_MARKETING_SHARE_BELOW_MINIMUM, because round_half_up(1000000 * 0.60) == 600000 and 599999 < 600000

neither refusal is ERR_FUNDING_RATIO_BELOW_MINIMUM even though the district has no statements and the ratio would be 0.0000, because the share caps sit at priority 85 and the funding ratio at priority 90
neither refusal is ERR_ADMIN_SHARE_EXCEEDED: 150000 == round_half_up(1000000 * 0.15) and an administration share exactly on its cap is accepted
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_cont_id}.status and AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_mkt_id}.status are both still BOARD_REVIEW with approver_user_id null and approved_at null

name: amendment_variance_is_measured_against_the_stored_total_and_admits_exactly_the_allowance
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, FY2027-Q1 generated, st1 filed 824,500 and st2 filed 340,000
plan FY2027 APPROVED at total 1,000,000 with forecast 1,164,500 and funding_ratio 1.1645
assert: the 1,260,000 proposal returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_AMENDMENT_VARIANCE_EXCEEDED, because abs(1260000 - 1000000) == 260000 > round_half_up(1000000 * 0.25) == 250000
that refusal is not ERR_FUNDING_RATIO_BELOW_MINIMUM: round_half_up(1164500 / 1260000, 4) == 0.9242 which clears 0.9000, so only the variance ceiling can refuse it
that refusal is not a share-cap error: 800000 >= round_half_up(1260000 * 0.60) == 756000, 180000 <= round_half_up(1260000 * 0.15) == 189000 and 120000 <= round_half_up(1260000 * 0.10) == 126000
after the refusal AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.revision_count == 0, total_budget_cents == 1000000, sales_and_marketing_cents == 650000 and version == ${wp_v_approved}
the 1,250,000 proposal returns 200 with the same expected_work_plan_version, because abs(1250000 - 1000000) == 250000 is exactly the allowance and the comparison is <=

AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.total_budget_cents == 1250000 with sales_and_marketing_cents == 800000, administration_cents == 180000, contingency_reserve_cents == 120000 and destination_events_cents == 150000
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.revision_count == 1, status == APPROVED and ${wp_v_amended} == ${wp_v_approved} + 1
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.funding_ratio == 0.9316, because round_half_up(1164500 / 1250000, 4) == 0.9316 and the forecast itself did not move

name: the_funding_ratio_refuses_the_unfunded_fiscal_year_while_the_funded_one_approves
setup: canonical district ACTIVE with the single period FY2027-Q1, st1 filed 824,500 and st2 filed 340,000
plan FY2027 already APPROVED at total 1,000,000

payload.note: board vote on the fiscal 2028 plan

assert: the fiscal 2028 plan is created 201 and sponsored 200, reaching BOARD_REVIEW with total_budget_cents == 1000000
the APPROVE returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_FUNDING_RATIO_BELOW_MINIMUM
the forecast for fiscal 2028 is 0 because the district's only period is labelled FY2027-Q1 and no period label begins with FY2028, so funding_ratio == 0.0000 < 0.9000
the refusal is not a share-cap error: 650000 >= 600000, 150000 <= 150000 and 100000 <= 100000 all hold on a 1,000,000-cent total
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp28_id}.status is still BOARD_REVIEW with approver_user_id null
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.status is still APPROVED with funding_ratio == 1.1645 and assessment_revenue_forecast_cents == 1164500, so the failed fiscal 2028 approval left the fiscal 2027 plan untouched
the two plans coexist: GET /districts/${d_id}/annual-work-plans returns both rows, one APPROVED for 2027 and one BOARD_REVIEW for 2028

name: the_lodging_tax_match_is_bounded_by_the_pool_and_by_half_the_approved_plan_total
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, st1 and st2 filed, plan FY2027 APPROVED at total 1,000,000 -> match ceiling round_half_up(1000000 * 0.50) == 500000
DMO agreement EXECUTED with lodging_tax_match_pool_cents 400,000 and nothing committed yet
assert: the 400,000 program returns 201 and District.${d_id}.lodging_tax_match_committed_cents == 400000, exactly the pool and below the 500000 ceiling
lowering the pool to 300,000 returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_LODGING_TAX_MATCH_EXHAUSTED, because 400000 already committed exceeds the proposed pool
after that refusal District.${d_id}.lodging_tax_match_pool_cents is still 400000 and District.${d_id}.version did not change, so a refused coordination call writes nothing at all
raising the pool to 900,000 returns 200 and leaves lodging_tax_match_committed_cents at 400000
the 100,001 program returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_LODGING_TAX_MATCH_CAP_EXCEEDED, because 400000 + 100001 == 500001 > min(500000, 900000)
that refusal is not ERR_LODGING_TAX_MATCH_EXHAUSTED: the 900,000 pool has room, so only the plan-derived ceiling binds
that refusal is not ERR_PROGRAM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: committed_program_cents would be 500001, still under sales_and_marketing_cents 650000
the 100,000 program returns 201 and District.${d_id}.lodging_tax_match_committed_cents == 500000, exactly the ceiling, because the comparison is <=
AnnualWorkPlan.${wp_id}.committed_program_cents == 500000 over the two surviving programs, and GET /annual-work-plans/${wp_id}/marketing-programs returns exactly ${mp_pool_id} and ${mp_cap_id}
GET /districts/${d_id}/financial-summary with fiscal_year 2027 reports lodging_tax_match_committed_cents == 500000

name: a_qualifying_tally_is_still_refused_while_the_assessable_pool_holds_fewer_than_three_businesses
setup: logical clock 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z
a second district Tidepool Commons PROPOSED with only two assessable properties, both of which have signed its FORMATION drive
assert: the first tally returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_PETITION_POOL_TOO_SMALL, because the assessable pool holds 2 businesses and MIN_PETITION_POOL is 3
the drive opened with assessable_count_snapshot == 2 and assessable_basis_snapshot_cents == 80000000, and a FORMATION drive snapshots required_weighted_pct 0.6000 with required_headcount_pct 0.0000
after the refusal PetitionDrive.${pool_drive_id}.status is still OPEN with tallied_at null and short_reason NONE, so a pool refusal is not the SHORT_OF_THRESHOLD branch
after the refusal District.${pd_district_id}.status is still PETITION_CIRCULATING and has not cascaded to FORMATION_FAILED
the third property is created 201 and District.${pd_district_id}.assessable_business_count == 3 with assessable_basis_cents == 100000000
the second tally returns 200 with PetitionDrive.${pool_drive_id}.status == QUALIFIED and short_reason NONE
PetitionDrive.${pool_drive_id}.weighted_support_pct == 0.8000, because the recomputation divides the unchanged 80000000 of signed basis by the live 100000000 pool rather than by the 80000000 snapshot
PetitionDrive.${pool_drive_id}.headcount_support_pct == 0.6667, because round_half_up(2 / 3, 4) == 0.6667
the canonical Harbor Bay district is untouched by any of this: the two districts keep separate pools

Cove Cottages then revised to exempt_status GOVERNMENT_OWNED

LodgingBusiness.${b4_id}.status == EXEMPT with exempt_status == GOVERNMENT_OWNED
District.${d_id}.assessable_business_count == 3 and District.${d_id}.assessable_basis_cents == 95000000

the tally returns 200 with PetitionDrive.${pd_id}.status == QUALIFIED

name: a_remittance_may_be_reversed_once_and_the_second_reversal_is_refused
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, st1 filed 824,500 unpaid, st2 filed 340,000 with a single APPLIED 300,000 remittance

payload.reversal_reason: ACH returned unpaid by the operator's bank
second attempt at the same reversal

assert: the first reversal returns 200 with Remittance.${rem_st2_id}.status == REVERSED
AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.principal_paid_cents == 0, credit_balance_cents == 0, total_due_cents == 340000 and payment_status == UNPAID
District.${d_id}.collected_to_date_cents == 0, because st1 was never paid and st2's only payment has been reversed
the second reversal returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_REMITTANCE_ALREADY_REVERSED
the refusal is not ERR_REMITTANCE_NOT_FOUND: the remittance exists and belongs to this statement, it is merely no longer APPLIED
after the refusal Remittance.${rem_st2_id}.status is still REVERSED and its version did not move a second time
after the refusal AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.principal_paid_cents is still 0 and District.${d_id}.collected_to_date_cents is still 0, so nothing was credited twice

name: a_granted_adjustment_may_equal_but_not_exceed_the_effective_assessment
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, st2 filed 340,000 and unpaid; no work plan exists, so no funding-ratio cascade can fire
a CALCULATION_ERROR dispute on st2 claiming 340,001 has been docketed UNDER_REVIEW

payload.dispute_note: the whole quarter was misclassified, plus a cent of rounding

payload.resolution_note: one cent past a full abatement

assert: the dispute itself was filed 201 with claimed_adjustment_cents == 340001, because nothing bounds what an operator may ask for
the 340,001 resolution returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_ADJUSTMENT_EXCEEDS_ASSESSMENT
after that refusal AssessmentDispute.${dsp2_id}.status is still UNDER_REVIEW with version == ${dsp2_v_under_review} and resolved_by_user_id null
after that refusal AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.granted_adjustment_cents == 0, effective_assessment_cents == 340000 and total_due_cents == 340000
the 340,000 resolution returns 200, because the comparison is <= and a full abatement is lawful
AssessmentDispute.${dsp2_id}.status == RESOLVED_ADJUSTED with resolved_by_user_id == "hearing-01"
AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.granted_adjustment_cents == 340000, effective_assessment_cents == 0 and total_due_cents == 0
AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.payment_status == PAID_IN_FULL and not REFUND_DUE, because credit_balance_cents is still 0 and the REFUND_DUE branch needs a positive credit
AssessmentStatement.${st2_id}.principal_paid_cents == 0 and GET /assessment-statements/${st2_id}/remittances returns an empty list, so the statement was retired without a payment
LodgingBusiness.${b2_id}.status is still ASSESSABLE, because the granted dispute was CALCULATION_ERROR and only an EXEMPT_PROPERTY grant moves the property to EXEMPT
District.${d_id}.collected_to_date_cents == 0, so an abatement is not collection

name: room_night_claims_are_bounded_by_room_count_times_nights_at_submission_and_at_verification
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, plan FY2027 APPROVED, DMO agreement EXECUTED, program RUNNING with booking window [2026-09-01, 2026-12-01)
logical clock 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z; Lighthouse Boutique holds 60 rooms
assert: the 121-night submission returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_CLAIM_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY, because 60 rooms times the 2 whole nights of [2026-09-10, 2026-09-12) is 120
that refusal is not ERR_CLAIM_OUTSIDE_BOOKING_WINDOW: the stay sits inside [2026-09-01, 2026-12-01)
GET /marketing-programs/${mp_id}/room-night-claims returns no row for the refused submission
the 120-night submission returns 201 with RoomNightClaim.${rnc_cap_id}.status == SUBMITTED and verified_room_nights null, because the physical ceiling is inclusive
the verification allowing 121 returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_CLAIM_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY, because verified_room_nights may not exceed the claim's own 120
after that refusal RoomNightClaim.${rnc_cap_id}.status is still SUBMITTED with verified_room_nights null and verified_by_user_id null
the verification allowing 120 returns 200 with status == VERIFIED, verified_room_nights == 120 and verified_by_user_id == "dmo-01"
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.status is still RUNNING throughout, since verification never advances the program

name: a_stay_outside_the_half_open_booking_window_is_refused_and_the_closing_edge_is_accepted
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, program RUNNING with booking window [2026-09-01, 2026-12-01), logical clock 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z
assert: the [2026-12-01, 2026-12-03) stay returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_CLAIM_OUTSIDE_BOOKING_WINDOW, because stay_start equals the exclusive booking_window_end
that refusal is not ERR_CLAIM_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY: 50 <= 60 rooms times 2 nights
the [2026-11-29, 2026-12-01) stay returns 201 with RoomNightClaim.${rnc_edge_id}.status == SUBMITTED and room_nights == 50, because stay_end may land exactly on the exclusive bound
the two stays do not overlap each other, so neither call can return ERR_CLAIM_STAY_OVERLAP
GET /marketing-programs/${mp_id}/room-night-claims returns exactly one row, ${rnc_edge_id}

name: the_renewal_window_opens_exactly_one_hundred_eighty_days_before_expiration_and_shuts_at_it
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, formed_on 2026-08-01 with term_years 1 -> expiration_date 2027-08-01
no TransparencyRecord of any kind exists, so the district cannot satisfy the renewal transparency gate

payload.reason: renewal requested a day too early on a district with no published filings

assert: at 2027-02-01 the RENEWAL drive returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_RENEWAL_WINDOW_NOT_OPEN, because 2027-02-01 is 181 whole days before 2027-08-01 and RENEWAL_WINDOW_DAYS is 180

at 2027-02-01 the RENEWAL_PENDING lifecycle call returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_TRANSPARENCY_REQUIREMENTS_UNMET and NOT ERR_RENEWAL_WINDOW_NOT_OPEN, because the transparency gate sits at priority 70 and the window at priority 75
District.${d_id}.status is still ACTIVE after that refusal
at 2027-02-02 the RENEWAL drive returns 201, because that instant is exactly 180 whole days before expiration_date and the bound is inclusive

PetitionDrive.${pd_renew_id}.drive_type == RENEWAL, status == OPEN, required_weighted_pct == 0.6500 and required_headcount_pct == 0.7500, snapshotted from renewal_threshold_pct and renewal_headcount_threshold_pct rather than from formation_threshold_pct
PetitionDrive.${pd_renew_id}.assessable_count_snapshot == 4 and assessable_basis_snapshot_cents == 100000000
District.${d_id}.status is still ACTIVE, because only a FORMATION drive moves a district into PETITION_CIRCULATING
at 2027-08-02 the RENEWAL drive returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_RENEWAL_WINDOW_NOT_OPEN, because the window is closed once the clock is past expiration_date
GET /districts/${d_id}/petition-drives with drive_type RENEWAL returns exactly one row, ${pd_renew_id}

name: a_program_closure_waits_for_every_submitted_claim_to_be_verified
setup: canonical district ACTIVE, program RUNNING with committed_cents 62,000 and booking window [2026-09-01, 2026-12-01)
one 100-night claim from Lighthouse Boutique sitting in SUBMITTED

payload.closure_note: closing while a claim is still pending
closing now that every claim is verified

assert: the first closure returns 409 with data.error_id == ERR_CLAIMS_PENDING_VERIFICATION
after that refusal MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.status is still RUNNING with closed_at null, verified_room_nights null and performance_flag NOT_MEASURED
the verification returns 200 with RoomNightClaim.${rnc_b3_id}.status == VERIFIED and verified_room_nights == 100
the second closure returns 200 with MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.status == CLOSED and closed_at == 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.verified_room_nights == 100 and gross_cost_per_room_night_cents == 620, because round_half_up(62000 / 100) == 620
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.efficiency_tier == TIER_EFFICIENT, because 620 <= 1500
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.dmo_cost_share_cents == 24800 and net_district_cost_cents == 37200, because round_half_up(62000 * 0.40) == 24800
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.net_cost_per_room_night_cents == 372 and performance_index == 6.7204, because round_half_up(2500 / 372, 4) == 6.7204
MarketingProgram.${mp_id}.performance_flag == MEETS_BENCHMARK, because the index is at or above 1.0000
had the closure been allowed while the claim was SUBMITTED the program would have published verified_room_nights 0 with efficiency_tier TIER_UNPRODUCTIVE, which is exactly what the gate prevents
